notes: Release is blocked by F002 and F003. Their geometry fields are non-executable placeholders; suppress unresolved features rather than cutting their placeholder rectangles. This is not a claim that the remaining envelope equals the finished guide body.

X runs left to right in the plan, Y runs bottom to top in the plan, Z runs toward datum A. The front elevation is viewed from -Y; end-hole sketch coordinates are global (Y,Z), not the end-view horizontal and vertical coordinates.

All blind drill depths are modeled to full diameter with flat bottoms under standard drafting convention; drill-point cones are cosmetic. Threads, including NPTF, are cosmetic on the printed drill diameters. Thread depths are retained in the thread metadata independently of drill depths.

After resolving the compound guide machining, rebind affected corner-hole starting faces to the resulting machined surfaces. Do not silently substitute the raw envelope face when a guide operation removes that face.

Do not force rounded dimension loops closed: the three-hole middle ordinate is 1.312 and full span is 2.625; end-face columns retain .312 and 3.750 independently of 4.38 overall thickness; T-slot enlargement retains 1.25 and its printed .28 lower lip offset independently of .688 throat width.
Maintain dowel-specific ±.001 dimensions and diametric tolerance independently of the neighboring tapped-hole coordinates.

Preserve drawing notes: B and C in line and perpendicular to A .002; D and E parallel to B and C and perpendicular to A .002; F,J,K,M in line and parallel to A .002; G,H,L,N in line and parallel to A .002. These controls are not additional material-removal features.

Material is IE357 STEEL. IE421 hole classes A/B, IE500 thread requirements and IE2122 surface-texture codes require the referenced company specifications; do not invent their definitions or numerical finishes.

Nominal geometry uses the printed inch dimensions. Apply the title-block precision tolerances and specifically printed tolerances separately; extraction zero tolerance fields do not mean zero tolerance.
Revision 2, DEC 2,75. No uncalled-for edge breaks, chamfers, countersinks or counterbores have been added.
